note: Qwen KV/system die plan v3 (PLAN-KVv3 10-23): v2 row lattice (16 x 1520.64-um rows, 4 HBM PCs per row, W/E = MY, N half = MX about the centre band) with hg split outer/inner (1278.72 um each), the centre band as 5 hub partitions (PLL + clock spine root in hub_C = die centre), IO row = sys_c (UCIe + d2d, N-edge centre) + sys_E (SerDes); d2d <-> hub in two straight corridors symmetric about the PV axis (hgi_WN col -> hub_Wi, hgi_EN col -> hub_Ei -> hub_C). N-W IO-row corner (cols 0-2, 3.18 x 1.73 mm) has no partition: the IO row height is set by the SerDes macro. Clock insertion budget per type = 140 ps + 0.2 ps/um x half-perimeter (PLAN-TOOL CP1 measurement, min 250). As-built rtl6 (e33504a6f) connectivity.
